chapter: Metronome, Billie Holiday, Cleveland and Atlantic
title: Gotham Records and meeting Frankie Lymon
summary: He made sides for Gotham in Philadelphia and met Frankie Lymon on a TV film.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: When did you start playing "Frankie and Johnny" and "Annie Laurie."
There was a record company in Philadelphia called Gotham. And I made quite a few sides for them.

Yeah that's when I first met Frankie Lymon. We were on the same little TV thing he made -- a little film. And I think we made it in Delaware -- Willmington Delaware. And this little kid was singin' boy -- and I was on the same thing. So in the mean time we were recording for Gotham -- we made a few sides for them. That's where "Frankie and Johnny Boogie" came. #then
